method_note: first-added date and stats are reconstructed at month-end granularity from git history; six-month downloads use the first month-end stats snapshot on/after first_seen+6 months.
pr_count_note: GitHub Search API PR-created counts were not used (rate-limited/unreliable from this environment); monthly file-list commits and PR-numbered commit subjects are retained as local git evidence, but they are accepted-change proxies, not full submission counts.
